description: Tests for the data-access analyzer on Go code — fmt.Sprintf SQL injection vs $1 parameterized queries. Tenancy is declared in .codeauditor.json (analyzerConfigs.data-access.orgFilterTables: ["users"]), so missing-org-filter has a declared tenant table to check: parameterized.go's SELECT on users fires missing-org-filter (critical), while its INSERT on users is excluded by design (an insert carries the tenant column as a value, not a predicate). The INSERT is also not an unfiltered write — Spec 68 disposition (a) makes the write set UPDATE-only for Go and TypeScript alike: INSERT is row-adding and a bare DELETE is whole-table maintenance, so neither is a missing-filter defect. Without the declaration the rule's input is absent and the finding would silently read clean instead of firing.
